summary: Singleton of esv::inventory::InteractionSystem (queried together with ReplicateMembersRequestComponent, MemberUnloadRequestComponent and MemberChangesSingletonComponent, query registered at bg3.exe+0x3499210) and read by esv::notification::System. Alive in every level (idle), seen empty. It is a HashMap with trivially destructible values; the value type was not established, so the value array is given as its raw parts.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: HashMap bucket table pointer (HashKeys). Adder bg3.exe+0x348B300 zeroes +0..+0x38 in the HashMap pattern (sizes at +0x1C and +0x2C); destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 frees +0x30 then calls the HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 (frees +0x20, +0x10, +0).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: bucket count of the HashMap (0 when never used).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: HashMap NextIds chain array (freed by the HashSet destructor).

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: HashMap key array; 8-byte keys, assumed EntityHandle as in every other inventory map of this system (macOS: InteractionSystem keeps HashMap<ID<EntityHandleTraits>, ...> for its per-container data).

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: value array pointer; values are trivially destructible (freed without per-element destructor); element type/size not established.

open_questions: Value type of the map (it should become HashMap<EntityHandle, T>); key type assumed EntityHandle.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
second_pass: Not settled: the value type of the map was not established on the Windows side; the bg3.exe query that names this singleton (bg3.exe+0x347C370) only removes the singleton entity at shutdown.
